messages:
sarah: Quick follow-up from yesterday's PM for the gen-serve latency spike. I sketched an assignment plan so we don't lose momentum — please reply with 'take' or reassign. I'll lock owners after confirmations.

sarah: Proposed tasks (short names + Jira):
1) Query planner regression deep-dive — RED-3102 (2w)
2) Cache TTL & eviction audit — RED-3105 (1w)
3) Canary rollback automation + playbook — RED-3110 (3w)
4) Recurrence analysis (detect repeating patterns across regions) — RED-3120 (1w)

sarah: Quick notes: RED-3102 needs perf traces + explain-plan diffs, RED-3105 needs an eviction harness, RED-3110 needs runbook + CI gating, RED-3120 needs log sampling & SQL frequency analysis. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3102 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3105

devon: I can take RED-3102. Will start with explain plans + perf tests tomorrow. take

alex: I'll take RED-3105 (cache TTL/eviction). Need help from infra to repro eviction pressure — tagging @simon for harness infra. take

priya: I can own the RACI doc + integration tests validation. Suggest R=devon, A=alex, C=priya, I=eng-lead for RED-3105. I'll make a short checklist.

simon: created RED-3110 and added initial acceptance criteria + doc stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3110. I can work on the canary rollback script. take

sarah: Thanks — current tentative assignment: RED-3102 -> devon, RED-3105 -> alex, RED-3110 -> simon, RED-3120 -> unassigned. Need one person for recurrence analysis (RED-3120).

devon: I can pair with priya on RED-3120 but would prefer to focus primary on RED-3102. Happy to own recurrence analytic queries jointly (devon+priya).

alex: I'll add the eviction test matrix today and drop a short repro guide. If infra needed for sustained load I'll file infra task.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up review for thread 2560004567 scheduled in 7 days.

sarah: Ok locking owners per confirmations: RED-3102 -> devon; RED-3105 -> alex; RED-3110 -> simon; RED-3120 -> priya (owner) + devon (support). I'll update Jira assignees and set due dates: 2w/1w/3w/1w respectively.

priya: Added RACI doc and checklist (doc link in RED-3102 comment). Created subtasks in RED-3120 for log sampling + recurrence query.

simon: pushed PR template for rollback scripts -> will add to RED-3110. :eyes:

alex: Noted. I'll comment on RED-3105 when the eviction harness is up.

sarah: Thanks all — I'll run a short handoff meeting tomorrow 10am to sync owners, then we'll have the 7-day follow-up. If you need to swap owners, reply here before EOD. :thumbsup:
